Few places in the world can match the allure of the Big Island. Whether you are planning a trip to the Big Island for the first time or returning for more, there is always something new to discover.

## Best Time to Visit

The ideal time to explore the Big Island depends on what you want to experience. Autumn paints the scenery in golden hues with fewer crowds.

## Top Attractions

- Iconic landmarks that define the Big Island
- Hidden spots only locals know about
- Historical sites that tell the story of USA
- Scenic viewpoints for unforgettable photos

## Local Cuisine

No trip to the Big Island is complete without sampling the local food. From street-side vendors to fine dining establishments, the culinary scene reflects the region's rich heritage and innovative spirit.

## Getting Around

A mix of public transport and occasional taxis offers the best balance of convenience and cost in the Big Island.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts and budget hostels coexist in the Big Island, giving travelers plenty of options.
